status: NO-GO for automatic tracked-discount redemption until provider, device, reporting and tax acceptance
review_type: Official documentation review and proposed acceptance protocol; no Square transactions or tax approvals performed

verified_capabilities_and_limits.finding: Orders API can retrieve orders completed in Square POS and exposes order-related webhooks. This does not establish a supported way to insert a custom credit prompt into every native checkout.

Square documents that orders not created through the API omit version and cannot be updated. The current settlement code deliberately requires versioned evidence; native versionless orders need an approved separate proof design.
Catalog discounts support a tax-basis setting. Configuring that setting is an integration capability, not a legal classification of a customer's credit.

Square exposes the actually applied discount amount and its order-local UID, alongside catalog identity. Reconciliation must match the approved discount and applied cents rather than its display name or requested amount.

Square's current sales-summary documentation distinguishes discounts, returns, taxes, collected funds and multiple sales metrics; report timing and inclusion of open checks can differ. A discount cannot be promised to behave like a tender or gift-card redemption in every report.

Idaho Rule044 requires qualifying trade property to enter resale inventory, documented purchased and traded goods by sale time, ownership by the buyer, and delivery/purchase within one transaction. Rule051 treats retailer discounts and gift certificates differently. Inference: credit earned on one visit and spent later must not automatically receive same-transaction trade-in treatment merely because the app labels it trade credit.

current_code_policy.unsupported_evidence: review-only exception; never guess a debit, refund restoration or released hold

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Seller identity, locations and actual granted scopes match consent; no cross-store token use; Square credentials remain server-side and absent from desktop, URLs and logs. The encrypted local staff session is a separate credential.
Refresh rotates safely; revoked access stops provider calls and mutations. Separate seller-content deletion/offboarding gate remains open.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Native checkout for every supported POS/device edition
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Record exact device/app versions and actual order/payment evidence. Prove how a customer and reservation attach before checkout. Unsupported/versionless flows remain blocked.

One reservation, approved catalog discount/version/tax basis, actual applied cents no greater than reserved cents, terminal-order/payment proof and exactly one debit. Unused reserved cents release only from verified evidence; both PCs show the same authoritative balance.
Prove zero-payment completion and tax behavior on the selected device. Absence of payment is never treated as sufficient completion proof.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Two tills, same shopper, simultaneous checkout
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Available balance cannot be overspent; held amounts are visible; failed requests preserve keys; one authoritative outcome per sale.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Timeout, crash, duplicate/reordered/missed webhook and reconnect
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Recover the same request outcome with no duplicate debit. Signed ingress, replay protection and an explicit missed-event catch-up strategy must pass. Missing evidence holds for review rather than inventing a result.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Cancel, changed cart, removed discount and delayed payment
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: No early debit or unsafe release. Final customer, location, currency, discount identity, tax basis and amount must match the approved immutable terms.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Itemized partial/full return, repeated return and amount-only refund
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Restore only the proven tracked credit allocation once, capped by original use. Unsupported refunds require review; they do not automatically recreate credit.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Cashier substitutes similarly named discount or changes tax setting
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Wrong identity/version/tax basis fails closed and creates a review exception without a customer ledger mutation.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Square Dashboard and exported sales/discount/tax/payment reports
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: For approved fictional sales, save before/after values, report definitions/filters/location/timezone/business-day cutoff and settled timing. Bookkeeper approves each requested accounting outcome.

proposed_live_acceptance_cases.case: Origin-specific Idaho tax examples and mixed-origin balance
proposed_live_acceptance_cases.pass: Written owner/tax-adviser decision covers same-transaction inventory trade, deferred trade credit, refund credit, promotional credit and purchased stored value. Unapproved origins remain blocked.

owner_decisions: Which exact Square POS, Retail, Register, Terminal or app-owned checkout combinations are in the launch support matrix?
Which credit origins are offered, and can they be transferred, redeemed for cash, refunded or expire? Do not implement legal terms by inference.
Obtain written Idaho treatment for deferred credit and same-transaction trade allowances, including required sale/ownership/inventory documentation and mixed-origin redemption.
Choose and approve the desired Square report definitions and accounting treatment; a request to reduce one metric is not authority to change tax basis.

Choose business entity, public support/privacy URLs and commercial terms before Marketplace submission. The current Marketplace requirements and approval must be checked in the actual Square Developer Dashboard; no listing approval is claimed.
evidence_still_required: Device-by-device checkout, receipts and redacted API evidence
Two physical desktop computers using the hosted ledger
Bookkeeper-approved reporting comparisons and written tax classification
Square Marketplace integration review and acceptance
Seller-content offboarding and privacy/legal release gates
implementation_gaps_still_open: Hosted Square status currently reports requested scopes, not token-status introspection of actual granted scopes.
Completed authoritative order evidence is the current consumption signal; independent payment checks and zero-payment device behavior still require an approved proof contract and live acceptance.
Webhook job retry exists; a missed-webhook catch-up scan is not implemented.

Active desktop receiving still uses its local Square vault and local operation journal. A typed server-side receiving/catalog/inventory saga through hosted OAuth, re-consented write scopes, permissions and two-PC deduplication remain to build. Existing uncertain local operations must retain their original keys and outcome recovery.
Accepting a hosted trade agreement does not itself receive Square inventory or establish the ownership and same-transaction evidence needed for Idaho trade-allowance treatment.
